parents.generate_plan: Combine the fastest single-token compact schedule with an atomic-free grouped GEMM2 finalize. Keep 6ebb0ad6's GEMM1 and compact local_slots/local_experts path, but change the T=1 GEMM2 kernel to write FP32 slot partials into a compact fixed [TOPK, H] workspace indexed by local slot. Launch a small finalize kernel over H that loops only local_slot_count slots, applies topk_weights and gemm2_bias with the parent semantics, casts directly to bf16, and writes zero when no local slot exists. Do not use the E_local expert_counts/expert_offsets path in this child.

Specialize the down-projection/finalize boundary for the qwen_tp2 T=1/top_k=10 route set by replacing the E_local-wide expert-major stage2 with a topk-slot grouped GEMM2 reducer. Build or reuse a compact local slot list, then launch a kernel over hidden-column tiles and local routed slots that uses the existing vectorized block32 GEMM2 dequant helper, applies router weights, accumulates the token's top-k contributions in a deterministic per-hidden-column path, and writes bf16 output directly. Keep GEMM1 warp-sliced mid production unchanged and keep a fallback to the current expert-major grouped finalize for larger T.

Front-load the T=1/TOPK<=10 local-slot compaction before GEMM1 and make both GEMM stages consume the same compact local slot arrays. For the fast path, build local_slots, local_experts, token_counts, and local_slot_count first, launch GEMM1 only over the host-known TOPK upper bound with device guards against slot_idx >= local_slot_count[0], and write mid_compact[slot_idx, i] instead of mid[topk_slot, i]. Then pass the same compact slot index to the existing single-token GEMM2 path. Keep GEMM1/GEMM2 arithmetic, FP4 decode helpers, router weights, and fallback paths unchanged; the isolated change is scheduling the local expert work once and reusing it across both GEMMs.

constraints: Preserve Qwen3.5 Plus TP2 routing/top_k/local expert semantics.
Each strategy must target exactly one optimization category.
